title: Add JMAP RefPlus informative note to Methods section
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Methods section (or Introduction): add an informative note that JMAP Chat implementations SHOULD support urn:ietf:params:jmap:refplus (draft-ietf-jmap-refplus-01) for ergonomic multi-step batch operations. Example use case: creating a Message and immediately using its returned ID in a Message/query filter within the same JMAP request array.
